LESSON: CERAMIC MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Materials for Production
Topic 3.2: Ceramic Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Ceramic Materials
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are ceramic materials used in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify common ceramic materials in the locality
2. describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify common ceramic materials in the locality

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify common ceramic materials in the locality.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify common ceramic materials in the locality” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify common ceramic materials in the locality” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify common ceramic materials in the locality" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify common ceramic materials in the locality
• Model 2: describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify common ceramic materials in the locality
2. Practise: describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Ceramic Materials.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are ceramic materials used in day-to-day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify common ceramic materials in the locality
• describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
